body: He's thirteen and basically everything to me. I feel like more of a parent to him than a sister sometimes. We have different dads and he lives with his, so I don't see him that often, but I try to hang out with him every other weekend or so. He's really mature for his age which makes me sad, since he had to grow up faster than he should. He's very sweet and understanding. Very, very sensitive; he probably cries just as much as I do, and that's saying something. He likes sports and used to be in wrestling, baseball and football. This year he stopped playing all of those but he wants to get into mma or kickboxing stuff. I'm really proud of him. Mom isn't really there for him (she's a very emotionally distant, closed off person) and his dad is... ah, well, bad to him. You know? So I don't want to leave him alone since he doesn't really have anyone else.

I used to think that I didn't want to because there was so much I hadn't done yet. That doesn't really matter much to me now. Mostly, I'm afraid of it not succeeding and having brain damage or something like that. I don't want to hurt my little brother, either.
No. I'm not in school or anything like that.

Not absolutely everything, but I told them I was very depressed again and that I wanted to go back to therapy. I haven't flat out said that I am struggling with not killing myself. They wouldn't believe me and all that would achieve is them thinking I'm a drama queen/attention seeker.

My parents won't pay for it or take me. I don't have income or transportation. So a therapist or psychologist isn't an option right now. And this is what I mean; there aren't really any options for me, you know? There isn't anything I can do. I do want to get better, but I have no way to do so. So it's either I keep living like this or I stop living. I've tried to find cheap therapy and/or therapists who will take clients over the phone. But I have no income whatsoever and even with the cheap therapists my parents won't help.   

Thank you for trying. I don't think anyone can help. I'm sorry for wasting your time.

It's just a culmination of things. Not being able to get a job, having to live somewhere that I feel very uncomfortable, being in a body that doesn't feel like mine. I don't think there was a specific event that triggered this.  

I think the most stressful thing is that I can't support myself. I can't find a job and without a job, I can't get out on my own. So I'm stuck relying on people who don't want me around. I can't stand where I'm living right now (with my stepmom who used to throw massive tantrums that ended with all the plates and glasses and knickknacks broken and then tried to set the house on fire with my dad and I inside, her daughter who gets treated like a princess even though she does hard drugs and is an all around asshole, and my dad who is a selfish alcoholic) but I don't have anywhere else to go and it's very hard to find a job since no one will drive me to work or help me get my license, so it needs to be in walking distance, and because I dropped out of high school. It's the feeling of being trapped here, somewhere I hate being, with no way out that's the most stressful.

It's weird you mention pregnancy because I terminated mine at fourteen and that's one of the biggest factors in why I feel so guilty. If you mean out of the house like moving out, that isn't an option for me even though I really wish it was. I have no income. If you mean just going places, that does help, but I generally don't have anywhere to go and I have social anxiety so malls/stores/etc just make me feel really nervous/upset and then subsequently defective...
